page.layout: Full-width title block at the top, in capitals. Below it, two parallel columns of author names: left column first, then right column. Running head faint at the top. Page number and catchword at the foot.

main_text.head: AVTORVM NOMINA, QVOrum testimonio in colligendis hisce Pontificum uitis, Ioan. Baleus praecipue usus est.

page.notes: The running head at the top is faint and partly overprinted by show-through; it could not be read reliably. "Sanfurdius" is uncertain: the letters are blurred. The two columns are shown in reading order (left, then right). The line "Coradus à Lichtenaw" is printed as "Lichtenau" with the final letters smudged; the reading is doubtful. The "¶ 3" at the foot is the signature and "Hec" the catchword.
